mapper.select: SELECT s.tenant_id FROM orbit_user_scope s JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id AND u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0' JOIN orbit_tenant t ON t.id=s.tenant_id AND t.enabled=1 WHERE s.user_id=#{user} AND s.enabled=1 FOR SHARE

SELECT b.id AS subject_id,b.team_id,s.data_role FROM orbit_business_user b JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=b.user_id AND u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0' JOIN orbit_user_scope s ON s.user_id=b.user_id AND s.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND s.enabled=1 JOIN orbit_business_team t ON t.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND t.id=b.team_id AND t.enabled=1 WHERE b.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND b.user_id=#{user} AND b.enabled=1 FOR SHARE

SELECT b.id AS subject_id,b.team_id, (b.enabled=1 AND t.enabled=1 AND u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0' AND s.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND s.enabled=1) AS usable FROM orbit_business_user b JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=b.user_id JOIN orbit_business_team t ON t.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND t.id=b.team_id LEFT JOIN orbit_user_scope s ON s.user_id=b.user_id WHERE b.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND b.id=#{owner} FOR SHARE
SELECT enabled FROM orbit_business_team WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{team} FOR SHARE

SELECT m.team_id FROM orbit_business_team_manager m JOIN orbit_business_team t ON t.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND t.id=m.team_id AND t.enabled=1 WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND m.manager_user_id=#{user} AND m.enabled=1 FOR SHARE
SELECT enabled FROM orbit_tenant WHERE id=#{tenant} FOR SHARE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orbit_rule_draft_idempotency(tenant_id,actor_id,idem_key,request_hash) VALUES(#{tenant},#{actor},#{key},#{hash}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE idem_key=idem_key
mapper.select: SELECT rule_id AS id,revision,request_hash FROM orbit_rule_draft_idempotency WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND actor_id=#{actor} AND idem_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,tenant_id,revision,state,body_json,body_hash,updated_at AS created_at FROM orbit_rule_draft WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT rule_id AS id,tenant_id,revision,state,body_json,body_hash,created_at FROM orbit_rule_draft_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND rule_id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.update: UPDATE orbit_rule_draft_idempotency SET rule_id=#{row.id},revision=#{row.revision} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND actor_id=#{actor} AND idem_key=#{key}
